_comment: Augments: offered (3 choices) at offer_rounds; pick one for a persistent bonus. kind 'economy' effects apply to the player economy; kind 'combat' effects apply to ALL of the player's units each fight. Edit freely.

augments.name: Onslaught
augments.description: +12% Attack Damage and +10% Attack Speed to all your units.

augments.name: Aegis
augments.description: +20 Armor and +20 Magic Resist to all your units.

augments.name: Wardstorm
augments.description: All your units start combat with a shield worth 15% of their max HP.

augments.name: Vampirism
augments.description: All your units gain 12% omnivamp (heal for a share of damage dealt).

augments.name: Sharpshooter
augments.description: +25% crit chance to all your units.

augments.name: Arcane Surge
augments.description: +30% Ability Power to all your units.

augments.name: Executioner
augments.description: All your units deal 12% of their damage as true damage.

augments.name: Regeneration
augments.description: All your units regenerate 6% max HP per second.

augments.name: Overclock
augments.description: 20% chance for your units' attacks to strike twice.

augments.name: Battlemage
augments.description: +20% Ability Power and units start combat with +20 mana.

augments.name: Fortress
augments.description: +25 Armor, +25 Magic Resist and +10% HP to all your units.

augments.name: Berserker's Rage
augments.description: +25% Attack Speed to all your units.
